content: Closed the last pending queue item. Turned an ad hoc practice (documented so far only inside one plugin role file, plugins/pmcro-aspire/agents/aspire.md) into a repo-wide convention in CONTEXT.md, which every role already reads before governed mutation. Along the way found and fixed a real leftover from trail 1de7efcb's correction pass: aspire.md's own frontmatter description still described an MCP server, the exact misconception that trail otherwise corrected everywhere else. Handled the two earlier deviating trails (eb6c47d4, d360b692) by naming them honestly in the new convention text rather than mutating their sealed evidence, per .pmcro/AGENTS.md's immutability rule. Also surfaced a real, separate gap while checking for a more formal promotion mechanism: plugins/pmcro-loop and its constraint-promotion tooling, described in .pmcro/runtime/references/knowledge-promotion.md, do not actually exist in this repo -- left unscoped rather than invented here. The PMCR-O queue is now empty of open items; no further next_seed filed since there is no known open work to hand forward.
